## Vulnerability Digest

No new vulnerabilities affecting the monitored products were verified as newly reported during the last 24 hours (2026-08-16 05:10 IST to 2026-08-17 05:10 IST).

The official CVE change feed and targeted vendor/advisory searches were reviewed. Same-day CVEs for unrelated third-party WordPress plugins were excluded because they do not match WordPress core, Yoast SEO, Advanced Custom Fields, or another named monitored component. No credible MongoDB-family or other possible matches requiring review remained after freshness, product-matching, and deduplication checks.

**Possible matches needing review:** None.

No immediate review is recommended based on new findings from this monitoring window. Continue routine patching and monitoring.

Source checked: [CVEProject cvelistV5](https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5).
